findings.why: worker.ACTIVE_STATES = {created, initializing, training, pausing, paused} does not contain the lifecycle's own WORK_STATES 'collecting' and 'validating' (the S1 worker moves every prep data run to 'collecting' and every prep smoke/verify and every eval run to 'validating') and does not contain the transient 'stopping'.  Such a row is refused as an 'unknown state', so the phase total raises and the train/eval entry refuses with 'ledger_timestamp_invalid' (a misleading reason: the timestamps are fine) instead of counting the row as the decision requires
